research_role: mechanism qualification on already consumed development evidence; no unseen or effectiveness claim
concrete_failure: In prospective qibolab C, the active construction state produced a complete trusted-goal-equivalent Pass at request 93, but the Agent never proposed a complete program and exhausted 120 requests. No clean replay occurred, so incumbent retention and fallback could not activate.

why_existing_mechanisms_are_insufficient.git_and_versions: They identify code and artifacts but do not transition a live Agent from search to program delivery.
why_existing_mechanisms_are_insufficient.primary_keys_transactions_and_uniqueness: They protect stored records but cannot cause candidate formation inside the model session.
why_existing_mechanisms_are_insufficient.types: They validate interface shapes but not whether the Agent invokes the replay tool after a verified success state.
why_existing_mechanisms_are_insufficient.ordinary_tests: Existing tests prove replay, certification, and fallback behavior after a candidate exists; they do not make a live session form that candidate.
why_existing_mechanisms_are_insufficient.prompt_guidance: The prospective failure directly shows that a written instruction is not a reliable executable trigger.

single_mechanism_change: When an existing harness-scheduled trusted complete-goal observation reports candidate_ready, the next request in the same active session is a controller-owned programization request that requires submit_and_replay. A replay Pass returns the certified program immediately; a replay Fail returns the exact counterexample and restores free repair.
unchanged: free shell operation space before the trigger and after replay failure
existing 16-shell scheduled observation cadence during qualification
deterministic_tests: candidate_ready observation produces one explicit handoff event
the next provider request requires submit_and_replay
clean replay Pass returns the certified program without another model request
clean replay Fail returns feedback and restores automatic tool choice
partial, failed, or unknown observations do not trigger handoff
soft replay and prior scheduled-observation runners remain behaviorally unchanged

consumed_live_qualification.primary_case: qibolab, because it contains the directly observed Pass-without-candidate failure
consumed_live_qualification.control: existing scheduled-observation runner with the same observation cadence
consumed_live_qualification.treatment: scheduled observation plus verifier-triggered programization and replay handoff
consumed_live_qualification.promotion_evidence: The trigger must activate, produce a complete candidate, execute replay, and preserve same-session repair after any replay failure. Official outcome and resources are descriptive only.

decision_policy: If the trigger does not activate on the consumed failure, does not produce a candidate, or introduces a new inability to repair replay failure, reject the mechanism before opening new prospective cases.
